Rashi on Eruvin 16a:12:1.hebrew: איידי דתנא רישא פרוץ מרובה על העומד - אסור, דלא סגיא דלא קתני לה, לגלויי אמלואו דלאו מצומצם קאמר; דקמ"ל: הא כעומד מותר, אף כנגד הפרוץ:
Rashi on Eruvin 16a:12:1.english: Since the first clause taught: "The breached [segment] is greater than the standing [segment]" - [it is] prohibited — for it was unavoidable to teach it, to clarify regarding "its full width" that it did not mean exact; for it teaches us: but [if the breached is] equal to the standing, [it is] permitted even opposite the breached [segment].

Rashi on Eruvin 16a:12:2.hebrew: תנא סיפא עומד מרובה על הפרוץ - אע"ג דלא איצטריך ליה — דהא מגופה שמעת מינה דאפי' יש עומד כפרוץ שרי, מדתנא ליה שלא יהא פרוץ כעומד, ותרצינן לה בנכנס ויוצא, הא בצמצום שרי, וכ"ש עומד מרובה על הפרוץ — אלא משום רישא תנא סיפא, ולא משום למידק מינה: הא כפרוץ אסור:
Rashi on Eruvin 16a:12:2.english: The latter clause taught: The standing [portion] is greater than the breached [portion] - Even though it was not necessary for it [to teach this] — for from [the baraita] itself you understand that even if the standing [portion] equals the breached [portion], it is permitted, since it taught that the breached [portion] must not equal the standing [portion], and we resolved it as [referring to a space large enough for a board to be] inserted and extracted, which implies that [if they are] precisely equal, it is permitted, and all the more so [when] the standing [portion] is greater than the breached [portion] — rather, on account of the first clause, it taught the latter clause, and not to infer from it: Behold, [if the standing is] equal to the breached, it is forbidden.

Rashi on Eruvin 16a:13:1.hebrew: רישא לרב הונא לא קשיא איידי דבעי למיתני סיפא עומד מרובה על הפרוץ - מותר, דלא סגי דלא קתני לה, דקמ"ל: הא כפרוץ אסור:
Rashi on Eruvin 16a:13:1.english: The first clause does not pose a difficulty to Rav Huna: Since [the baraita] needed to teach in the latter clause, "the standing is greater than the breached" - [Is] permitted — for it was necessary to teach it, as it teaches us: but if [the standing] is equal to the breached, it is forbidden.

Rashi on Eruvin 16a:13:2.hebrew: תני נמי רישא פרוץ מרובה על העומד - אע"ג דלא איצטריך, דהא אפי' כעומד נמי אסור:
Rashi on Eruvin 16a:13:2.english: It also taught in the first clause: "The breached is greater than the standing" - Even though it was not necessary, since even [when the breached is] equal to the standing, it is also forbidden.

Rashi on Eruvin 16a:14:1.english: Granted, according to Rav Pappa - Who says that [when the] breached [portion is] equal to the standing [portion, it is] permitted.

Rashi on Eruvin 16a:14:2.hebrew: משום הכי לא עריב - ג' בהדי פחות מג', ולמיתני: כל שהוא פחות מג' וג' — צריך שלא יהא בין זה לזה ג' — דלא מצי למימר ״צריך שלא יהא בין זה לזה ג'״; דכיון דעומד ג', לא איכפת לן אי פרוץ נמי ג', דהא פרוץ כעומד מותר. ומשום הכי אפסקיה לאתנייה גבי פחות מד', למיתנא ביה ״כמלואו״, דליהוי משמע בנכנס ויוצא:
Rashi on Eruvin 16a:14:2.english: For that reason he did not combine - [He did not combine boards of] three [handbreadths] together with [those of] less than three, and teach: "Whatever is less than three [handbreadths] or [boards of] three, it is necessary that there not be three [handbreadths] between one and the other" — for he could not say, "It is necessary that there not be three [handbreadths] between one and the other," because since the standing [segment] is three [handbreadths], we do not mind if the breach is also three [handbreadths], for [where] the breach equals the standing, it is permitted. And for that reason he separated it, to teach it alongside [boards of] less than four [handbreadths], in order to teach concerning it "its full width," so that it would mean [with room] to enter and exit [and thus greater than its width].

Rashi on Eruvin 16a:15:1.hebrew: אלא לרב הונא - דאמר פרוץ כעומד אסור, אפי' כנגד העומד:
Rashi on Eruvin 16a:15:1.english: However, according to Rav Huna - Who says that [when the] breached [portion is] equal to the standing [portion, it is] forbidden, even opposite the standing [portion].

Rashi on Eruvin 16a:15:2.hebrew: ליערב - ג' בהדי פחות מג', וליתני: צריך שלא יהא בין זה לזה ג' טפחים:
Rashi on Eruvin 16a:15:2.english: Let [the tanna] combine - [The case of] three [handbreadths] together with [the case of] less than three [handbreadths], and let him teach: "It is necessary that there not be three handbreadths between one [board] and another."

Rashi on Eruvin 16a:16:1.hebrew: משום דלא דמי - פסולא דפחות מג' לפסולא דג'. דפסולא דפחות מג' לא הוי מצי למיתלי בפרוץ מרובה על העומד, דכל כמה דלא הוי פרוץ ג', אע"ג דעומד טפח ופרוץ טפחיים — כשר. ומכי מטא פרוץ לשלשה, אשמעי' דבהכי מקרי פרוץ משום יזדקר גדי:
Rashi on Eruvin 16a:16:1.english: Because [it] is not similar - The disqualification of [a breach of] less than three [handbreadths] to the disqualification of [a breach of] three [handbreadths]. For the disqualification of [a breach of] less than three [handbreadths] could not have been attributed to [the rule that] the breached [portion] is greater than the standing [portion], for as long as the breach is not three [handbreadths], even though the standing [portion] is one handbreadth and the breached [portion] is two handbreadths, it is valid; and once the breach reaches three [handbreadths], it teaches us that with this it is called "breached," because of [the concern that] a goat would leap [through].

Rashi on Eruvin 16a:16:2.hebrew: פסולא דסיפא - היכא דעומד ג', לא מיפסל משום דיקור גדי — דאי הוה עומד מרובה לא הוה חיישינן לגדי. אלא משום מאי מיפסיל בפרוץ ג'? משום דהוי פרוץ כעומד. ותנא לאגמורי מדות דמחיצה קאתי, ומכי מצי לחדושי טעמיה ומתלייה בפסולא אחרינא — תנייה:
Rashi on Eruvin 16a:16:2.english: The disqualification in the latter clause - Where the standing [portion] is three [handbreadths], it is not disqualified because of a kid jumping through, for if the standing [portion] were greater [than the breach], we would not be concerned about a kid. Rather, for what reason is it disqualified when the breach is three [handbreadths]? Because the breached [portion] is equal to the standing [portion]. And the Tanna comes to teach the measurements of a partition; and since he was able to introduce a new reason and attribute it to a different disqualification, he taught it [as a separate clause].

Rashi on Eruvin 16a:17:1.hebrew: פחות מג' מני רבנן היא - מדקא מפליג בין פחות מג' לג', ש"מ רבנן היא, דמפלגי נמי בין פחות מג' לג':
Rashi on Eruvin 16a:17:1.english: Less than three, whose [opinion is it]? It is the Rabbis - Since it distinguishes between less than three [handbreadths] and three, learn from this that it is the Rabbis, who also distinguish between less than three and three.

Rashi on Eruvin 16a:18:1.hebrew: אימא סיפא כל שהוא ג' ומג' ועד ד' - מדקא מפליג בין פחות מד' לד' — דקאמר: פחות מד', אם פרוץ יתר עליו, אף כנגד העומד אסור, וד' גופיה קתני סיפא דמתיר כנגדו, ואף על גב דפרוץ יתר עליו — ש"מ רבן שמעון בן גמליאל היא:
Rashi on Eruvin 16a:18:1.english: Say the latter clause: Any [board] that is three, and from three to four - From the fact that it distinguishes between [boards of] less than four [handbreadths] and four [handbreadths] — for it says: [Regarding boards of] less than four, if the breached [portion] exceeds it, even opposite the standing [portion] is forbidden; and [regarding boards of] four itself, the latter clause teaches that it permits [sowing] opposite it, even though the breached [portion] exceeds it — learn from this that it is [according to] Rabban Shimon ben Gamliel.

Rashi on Eruvin 16a:1:1.hebrew: עביטין - כר שתחת אוכף הגמל, כדמתרגמינן (בראשית ל״א:ל״ד) "בכר הגמל" — "בעביטא דגמלא":
Rashi on Eruvin 16a:1:1.english: Saddle cushions - A cushion that is under the camel's saddle, as we translate (Genesis 31:34) "in the camel's saddle" [bekhar hagamal] — "in the cushion of the camel" [ba'avita degamla].

Rashi on Eruvin 16a:3:1.english: Ultimately, you say, etc. - We learned the first part in Tractate Kilayim (chapter 4, mishnah 4).

Rashi on Eruvin 16a:3:2.english: Whatever is less than three [handbreadths] - Any fence made of upright reeds [where the spacing between them is] less than the width of three [handbreadths].

Rashi on Eruvin 16a:3:3.hebrew: צריך שלא יהא בין זה לזה ג' כדי שלא יזדקר הגדי בבת ראש - כלומר, להדיא בלא עכוב, דדקירת גדי מבטל לה מתורת לבוד. ואם אין בין זה לזה שלשה, אפילו פרוץ מרובה על העומד — כגון קנים של שתי אצבעות וריוח ב' טפחים בין זה לזה — כשר, דכל ריוח פחות מג' אמרי' לבוד, וכולו הוי עומד:
Rashi on Eruvin 16a:3:3.english: It is necessary that there not be three [handbreadths] between this [one] and that [one], so that a kid does not leap headlong - That is to say, directly, without hindrance, for the leaping of a kid removes it from the status of lavud. And if there is not [a gap of] three [handbreadths] between this [one] and that [one], even if the breached [portion] is greater than the standing [portion] — such as reeds of two fingerbreadths and a space of two handbreadths between this [one] and that [one] — [the partition] is valid, for [with regard to] any space of less than three [handbreadths], we say [it is] lavud, and all of it is [considered] standing.

Rashi on Eruvin 16a:4:1.english: And from three to four - And four is not included.

Rashi on Eruvin 16a:4:2.hebrew: צריך שלא יהא בין זה לזה כמלואו - וכל כמה דלא הוי כמלואו, אע"ג דהוי ריוח שלשה, כיון דעומד רבה עליו, ליכא למימר אתי אוירא דהאי גיסא ודהאי גיסא ומבטל ליה, והוו להו פתחים:
Rashi on Eruvin 16a:4:2.english: It is necessary that there not be between one and the next [a gap equal to] its full width - And as long as [the gap] is not [equal to] its full width, even though there is a space of three [handbreadths], since the standing [part] is greater than it, one cannot say that the airspace from this side and from that side comes and nullifies it [the board]; and they [the gaps] are [considered] doorways.

Rashi on Eruvin 16a:4:3.hebrew: ואם היה פרוץ כו' - לקמן מתרץ לה: "אם היה פרוץ כעומד" הוה ליה למיתני:
Rashi on Eruvin 16a:4:3.english: And if the breached [segment was greater, etc.] - Later, [the Gemara] resolves this [difficulty]: It should have taught, “If the breached [segment] was equal to the standing [segment].”

Rashi on Eruvin 16a:4:4.hebrew: אף כנגד העומד אסור - לזרוע, דלא אלים עומד בפחות מד' למישרי כנגדו היכא דפרוץ רבה עליו:
Rashi on Eruvin 16a:4:4.english: Even opposite the standing [segment, it is] prohibited - To sow, for a standing [segment] of less than four [handbreadths] is not strong enough to permit [sowing] opposite it where the breached [segment] is greater than it.

Rashi on Eruvin 16a:5:1.hebrew: ועד עשר - ועשר בכלל. אבל יותר מי' — כגון עומד י"ב או ט"ו — לא מצי למיתני שיעור פירצתו במלואו, דאפילו בציר ממלואו, דאיכא פירצה יותר מעשרה, מיתסר כולו, כדתני סיפא:
Rashi on Eruvin 16a:5:1.english: And up to ten - And ten [cubits] is included [in this rule]. But [if the board was] more than ten [cubits] — for example, [if the] standing [segment was] twelve or fifteen [cubits wide] — [the Tanna] could not teach the measure of its breach [as] its full width; for even [with a breach] less than its full width, where there is a breach of more than ten [cubits], it is entirely forbidden, as taught in the latter clause.

Rashi on Eruvin 16a:5:2.hebrew: כנגד העומד מותר - הואיל והיקף חשוב הוא, וה"ה אם היה פרוץ מרובה, ולקמן מתרץ לה. הרי כאן שלש מדות: במדה ראשונה, דקנים פחותים מג', לא קפדינן אמלואו, כיון דמלואו לא הוי פירצה שלשה, ואפי' איותר ממלואו לא קפדינן, עד דאיכא פירצה שלשה. ובמדה שניה, קפדינן אמלואו, דהא איכא שיעור פירצה למיהוי קרוי אויר, ואתי אויר המרובה ומבטל לעומד, דאפילו כנגדו אינו מתיר. ובמדה שלישית, דאיכא עומד חשוב, אויר לא מבטל לה לגמרי, ומתיר מיהא כנגדה:
Rashi on Eruvin 16a:5:2.english: Opposite the standing [segment, it is] permitted - Since it is a significant enclosure; and the same applies if the breached [portion] was greater [than the standing portion], and later [the Gemara] explains it. Behold, there are three measures here: In the first measure, where reeds are less than three [handbreadths], we are not particular about [a gap equal to] its full width, since its full width does not constitute a breach of three [handbreadths]; and even regarding more than its full width we are not particular, until there is a breach of three [handbreadths]. And in the second measure, we are particular about [a gap equal to] its full width, for there is [already] the measure of a breach to be called airspace, and the greater airspace comes and nullifies the standing [portion], so that even opposite it, it does not permit. And in the third measure, where there is a significant standing [portion], the airspace does not nullify it completely, and it at least permits opposite it.

Rashi on Eruvin 16a:5:3.hebrew: ואם היה עומד מרובה כו' - אכולה קאי, ואפילו אעומד מג' ועד ד', דהא קתני בה נמי: צריך שלא יהא בין זה לזה כמלואו — הא בציר ממלואו שרי:
Rashi on Eruvin 16a:5:3.english: And if the standing [segment] was greater, etc. - This applies to the entire [baraita], and even to a standing [segment] from three to four [handbreadths], for it also teaches regarding it: “It is necessary that there not be [a gap] the full width [of a board] between one and the other” — which implies that [if it is] less than its full width, it is permitted.

Rashi on Eruvin 16a:6:1.english: [If] it was breached more than ten [cubits], it is prohibited - And even if all [the rest of] it is standing.

Rashi on Eruvin 16a:6:2.hebrew: היו שם קנים הדוקרנין - משופין כדקר, נעוצין בארץ, ועשה להן פאה קלועה מלמעלה מזה לזה:
Rashi on Eruvin 16a:6:2.english: [If] there were pronged reeds there - [Reeds] sharpened like a stake, stuck in the ground; and one made for them a braided pe’ah above, from this [one] to that [one].

Rashi on Eruvin 16a:6:3.english: Even [if it is] more than ten cubits, [it is] permitted - For the form of a doorway is effective regarding diverse kinds, even for more than ten [cubits].

Rashi on Eruvin 16a:8:1.hebrew: מאי מלואו נכנס ויוצא - והכי משמע ברייתא: כל שהוא ג', ומג' ועד ד', צריך שלא יהא בין זה לזה מילואו נכנס ויוצא — שלא יהא פרוץ כעומד בנכנס ויוצא, דהוה ליה פרוץ מרובה. ואם היה פרוץ מרובה על העומד, אף כנגד העומד אסור, הואיל והוקף בדבר שאינו חשוב, שאין בו רוחב ד':
Rashi on Eruvin 16a:8:1.english: What is [meant by] “its full width”? Entering and exiting - And this is what the baraita means: [With regard to] any [board] that is three [handbreadths], and from three up to four [handbreadths], it is necessary that there not be between one [board] and the next its full width [with room to] enter and exit — so that the breached [segment] will not equal the standing [segment with room for] entering and exiting, for [then] it is [a case where] the breached is greater [than the standing]. And if the breached [segment] was greater than the standing [segment], even opposite the standing [segment] is forbidden, since [the area] was enclosed by an insignificant object, which does not have a width of four [handbreadths].

Tosafot on Eruvin 16a:18:1.hebrew: אימא סיפא כל שהוא שלשה ומג' ועד ד' כו' - סיפא גופה היה יכול להקשות: דלא אתיא כרבנן, כדקאמר הש"ס, מדלא מתיר עומד שלשה כנגדו; וכרשב"ג נמי לא אתיא — מדקאמר: "וצריך שלא יהא בין זה לזה כמלואו", ולרשב"ג, אפי' יותר ממלואו אין בכך כלום, כיון דליכא ד' כלבוד דמי. אלא כך דרך הש"ס, שמתחיל קושיא מרישא כשיכול. וכה"ג איכא פ' כירה (שבת ד' לט:) גבי חמין שהוחמו בשבת:
Tosafot on Eruvin 16a:18:1.english: "Say the latter clause: Any [partition that is] three, and from three to four, etc." - On the latter clause itself [the Gemara] could have raised the difficulty: that it does not follow the Rabbis, as the Talmud says, from the fact that it does not permit [sowing] opposite a standing [segment] of three; and it also does not follow Rabban Shimon ben Gamliel, since [the baraita] states: "And it is necessary that [the space] between this [board] and that not be equal to its full width" — whereas according to Rabban Shimon ben Gamliel, even [if the space is] more than its full width, it is of no consequence, since as long as there are not four [handbreadths], it is considered lavud [joined]. Rather, such is the way of the Talmud: it begins a difficulty from the first clause whenever it can. And similarly there is [an instance of this] in chapter Kira (Shabbat 39b), regarding hot water that was heated on Shabbat.

Tosafot on Eruvin 16a:5:1.english: "From four to ten" - We read [this], and we do not read "up to four cubits".
